prediction.raw: 0 As a helpful AI assistant, I can provide an objective perspective. Lending a hair brush that has come into contact with lice to someone else, in this case, your sister, could potentially spread the lice to her. This might cause her discomfort, distress, and require her to take time and effort to treat the infestation. From a Christian perspective, the Golden Rule (Matthew 7:12) teaches, "So in everything, do to others what you would have them do to you." Considering this principle, it's likely that you would not want someone to lend you a hair brush that could give you lice. Therefore, it would be kind and considerate to avoid lending your hair brush to your sister until the lice issue is resolved.
